name: Spotted Sunfish
summary: At Lake Everstill, Spotted Sunfish draw fishers and hungry murlocs alike. The fish bring trade to Lakeshire, though murlocs make the shallows dangerous.

sections.title: A Prized Catch
sections.body: Spotted Sunfish bring trade to the Lakeshire piers. Dockmaster Baren buys them from the lake's steady catch, supplying food and commerce to a town under strain. Aggressive murloc tribes prowl the shallows and disrupt fishing. They gather sunfish at their camps, where travelers can take the fish by force.

faq.answer: Spotted Sunfish live in Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Anglers catch them in the lake, and murlocs gather them at camps along the shoreline.

faq.q: Who buys or needs Spotted Sunfish?
faq.answer: Dockmaster Baren buys Spotted Sunfish at the Lakeshire docks. He trades in the fish and pays for fresh stock.

faq.q: Why do the murlocs carry these fish?
faq.answer: Murlocs along Lake Everstill gather sunfish to feed their growing tribes. They keep their catches at camps along the shallows.

faq.q: Can you obtain them without fishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Travelers without a fishing rod can defeat the hostile murlocs along Lake Everstill's shores and take the fish they have gathered.

angles.text: As a cook, you can use Spotted Sunfish, a native freshwater fish and a fixture on tavern tables in Redridge.
